_note: Read only. /api/fleet-view/fleet is the fleet as OpenRig's own daemons report it (the daemon on this machine, FLEET_DAEMON_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:7433, and each HTTP host in its host list): machines, rigs and seats, machine health summaries, configured subscription links and usage readings. A reading is served from the last good read at once and refreshed outside the request; nothing polls when nobody asks. No token is read, stored or sent, and no request is made to a model provider.
